verses.en: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;
verses.pt: Palavra do SENHOR que veio ao profeta Jeremias, contra as nações.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet about the nations.

verses.en: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.
verses.pt: Quanto ao Egito: contra o exército de Faraó Neco, rei do Egito, que estava junto ao rio Eufrates em Carquemis, ao qual Nabucodonosor rei da Babilônia feriu no quarto ano de Jeoaquim filho de Josias, rei de Judá.
verses.en_web: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: Of Egypt: about the army of Pharaoh-neco, king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, overcame in the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

verses.en: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
verses.pt: Preparai os escudos maior e o menor, e vinde à guerra.
verses.en_web: “Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!
verses.en_bbe: Get out the breastplate and body-cover, and come together to the fight.

verses.en: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.
verses.pt: Selai os cavalos, e subi, vós os cavaleiros, e apresentai-vos com capacetes; limpai as lanças, vesti-vos de couraças.
verses.en_web: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail.
verses.en_bbe: Make the horses ready, and get up, you horsemen, and take your places with your head-dresses; make the spears sharp and put on the breastplates.

verses.en: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Por que razão vejo os medrosos tornando atrás? E seus guerreiros são abatidos, e vão fugindo, sem olharem para trás; o terror está por todos os lados,diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Why have I seen it? They are dismayed and are turned backward. Their mighty ones are beaten down, have fled in haste, and don’t look back. Terror is on every side,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: What have I seen? they are overcome with fear and turned back; their men of war are broken and have gone in flight, not looking back: fear is on every side, says the Lord.

verses.en: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
verses.pt: Não fuja o ligeiro, nem escape o guerreiro; para o norte, junto à margem do rio do Eufrates, tropeçaram e caíram.
verses.en_web: “Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.
verses.en_bbe: Let not the quick-footed go in flight, or the man of war get away; on the north, by the river Euphrates, they are slipping and falling.

verses.en: Who is this that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
verses.pt: Quem é este que sobe como o Nilo, cujas águas se movem como rios?
verses.en_web: “Who is this who rises up like the Nile, whose waters toss themselves like the rivers?
verses.en_bbe: Who is this coming up like the Nile, whose waters are lifting their heads like the rivers?

verses.en: Egypt riseth up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.pt: O Egito vem subindo como o Nilo, e suas águas se agitam como rios, e disse: Subirei, e cobrirei a terra; destruirei a cidade, e os que nela habitam.
verses.en_web: Egypt rises up like the Nile, and his waters toss themselves like the rivers. He says, ‘I will rise up. I will cover the earth. I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.’
verses.en_bbe: Egypt is coming up like the Nile, and his waters are lifting their heads like the rivers, and he says, I will go up, covering the earth; I will send destruction on the town and its people.

verses.en: Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.
verses.pt: Subi, cavalos, e rangei, carruagens; e saiam os guerreiros; os de Cuxe e os de Pute que tomam escudo, e os de Lude que tomam e encurvam o arco.
verses.en_web: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.
verses.en_bbe: Go up, you horses; go rushing on, you carriages of war; go out, you men of war: Cush and Put, gripping the body-cover, and the Ludim, with bent bows.

verses.en: For this is the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
verses.pt: Porém esse dia pertence ao Senhor DEUS dos exércitos, o dia de vingança, para ele se vingar de seus adversários; e a espada devorará, se fartará, e se embriagará do sangue deles; pois o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos tem para si um sacrifício na terra do norte, junto ao rio Eufrates.
verses.en_web: For that day is of the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge himself of his adversaries. The sword will devour and be satiated, and will drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
verses.en_bbe: But that day is the day of the Lord, the Lord of armies, a day of punishment when he will take payment from his haters: and the sword will have all its desire, drinking their blood in full measure: for there is an offering to the Lord, the Lord of armies, in the north country by the river Euphrates.

verses.en: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; for thou shalt not be cured.
verses.pt: Sobe a Gileade, e toma bálsamo, ó virgem filha do Egito; em vão multiplicas os remédios, pois não há cura para ti.
verses.en_web: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.
verses.en_bbe: Go up to Gilead and take sweet oil, O virgin daughter of Egypt: there is no help in all your medical arts; nothing will make you well.

verses.en: The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.
verses.pt: As nações ouviram da tua vergonha, e teu clamor encheu a terra: pois um guerreiro tropeçou contra outro guerreiro, e ambos juntamente caíram.
verses.en_web: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they both fall together.”
verses.en_bbe: Your shame has come to the ears of the nations, and the earth is full of your cry: for the strong man is falling against the strong, they have come down together.

verses.en: The word that the LORD spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Palavra que o SENHOR falou ao profeta Jeremias quanto à vinda de Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, para ferir a terra do Egito:
verses.en_web: The word that Yahweh spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon should come and strike the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: The word which the Lord said to Jeremiah the prophet, of how Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, would come and make war on the land of Egypt.

verses.en: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.
verses.pt: Anunciai no Egito, e declarai em Migdol; declarai também em Nofe e em Tafnes; dizei: Firma uma posição, e prepara-te; pois a espada está para devorar o que há ao redor de ti.
verses.en_web: “Declare in Egypt, publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes: say, ‘Stand up, and prepare; for the sword has devoured around you.’
verses.en_bbe: Give the news in Migdol, make it public in Noph: say, Take up your positions and make yourselves ready; for on every side of you the sword has made destruction.

verses.en: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.
verses.pt: Por que teus guerreiros foram derrubados? Não puderam ficar de pé, pois o SENHOR os empurrou.
verses.en_web: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn’t stand, because Yahweh pushed them.
verses.en_bbe: Why has Apis, your strong one, gone in flight? he was not able to keep his place, because the Lord was forcing him down with strength.

verses.en: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
verses.pt: Ele multiplicou os que tropeçaram; caíram cada um sobre o outro, e disseram: Levanta-te e voltemo-nos a nosso povo, e à terra de nosso nascimento, por causa da espada opressora.
verses.en_web: He made many to stumble. Yes, they fell on one another. They said, ‘Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.’
verses.en_bbe: ... are stopped in their going, they are falling; and they say one to another, Let us get up and go back to our people, to the land of our birth, away from the cruel sword.

verses.en: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.
verses.pt: Ali gritarão: O Faraó rei do Egito, é apenas um barulho; ele deixou passar o tempo determinado.
verses.en_web: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.’
verses.en_bbe: Give a name to Pharaoh, king of Egypt: A noise who has let the time go by.

verses.en: As I live, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
verses.pt: Vivo eu, diz o Rei, cujo nome é EU-SOU dos exércitos, que como o Tabor entre os montes, e como o Carmelo no mar, assim ele virá.
verses.en_web: “As I live,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so he will come.
verses.en_bbe: By my life, says the King, whose name is the Lord of armies, truly, like Tabor among the mountains and like Carmel by the sea, so will he come.

verses.en: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
verses.pt: Faz para ti a bagagem para a ida ao cativeiro, ó moradora, filha do Egito; porque Nofe se tornará em desolação, e será devastada até não haver ali morador.
verses.en_web: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant.
verses.en_bbe: O daughter living in Egypt, make ready the vessels of a prisoner: for Noph will become a waste, it will be burned up and become unpeopled.

verses.en: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
verses.pt: O Egito é uma bezerra formosa; mas a mosca carniceira vem do norte.
verses.en_web: “Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.
verses.en_bbe: Egypt is a fair young cow; but a biting insect has come on her out of the north.

verses.en: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.
verses.pt: Até seus soldados mercenários em meio dela são como bezerros cevados; porém também eles se virarão para trás, e juntamente fugirão; eles não permanecerão em postos, porque o dia de sua ruína, o tempo de sua punição, veio sobre eles.
verses.en_web: Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall; for they also are turned back. They have fled away together. They didn’t stand, for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.
verses.en_bbe: And those who were her fighters for payment are like fat oxen; for they are turned back, they have gone in flight together, they do not keep their place: for the day of their fate has come on them, the time of their punishment.

verses.en: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
verses.pt: Seu ruído sairá como de serpente; pois seus inimigos virão com poder; a ela virão com machados, como se fossem cortadores de lenha.
verses.en_web: It’s sound will go like the serpent; for they will march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.
verses.en_bbe: She makes a sound like the hiss of a snake when they come on with strength; they go against her with axes, like wood-cutters.

verses.en: They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.
verses.pt: Cortarão o seu bosque,diz o SENHOR, ainda que não possam ser contados; porque são mais que gafanhotos, não se pode enumerá- los.
verses.en_web: They will cut down her forest,” says Yahweh, “though it can’t be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.
verses.en_bbe: They will be cutting down her woods, for they may not be searched out; because they are like locusts, more than may be numbered.

verses.en: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
verses.pt: A filha do Egito será envergonhada; entregue será nas mãos do povo do norte.
verses.en_web: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.”
verses.en_bbe: The daughter of Egypt will be put to shame; she will be given up into the hands of the people of the north.

verses.en: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:
verses.pt: Diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que eu punirei a Amom de Nô, a Faraó e ao Egito; a seus deuses e a seus reis; tanto a Faraó como aos que nele confiam.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods, and her kings; even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: See, I will send punishment on Amon of No and on Pharaoh and on those who put their faith in him;

verses.en: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E os entregarei nas mãos dos que buscam tirar sua vida, e nas mãos de Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia, e nas mãos de seus servos; porém depois será habitada como nos dias anteriores,diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. Afterwards it will be inhabited, as in the days of old,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And I will give them up into the hands of those who will take their lives, and into the hands of Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, and into the hands of his servants: and later, it will be peopled as in the past, says the Lord.

verses.en: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.pt: Mas tu não temas, meu servo Jacó, nem te espantes, ó Israel; porque eis que te salvarei desde as terras de longe, e teus descendentes da terra de seu cativeiro. E Jacó voltará, descansará, e viverá em paz; e não haverá quem o atemorize.
verses.en_web: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.
verses.en_bbe: But have no fear, O Jacob, my servant, and do not be troubled, O Israel: for see, I will make you come back from far away, and your seed from the land where they are prisoners; and Jacob will come back, and will be quiet and in peace, and no one will give him cause for fear.

verses.en: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
verses.pt: Tu, meu servo Jacó, não temas,diz o SENHOR; pois eu estou contigo; porque destruirei por completo todas as nações entre as quais eu te lancei; porem a ti não destruirei por completo, mas te castigarei com moderação, e não te deixarei impune.
verses.en_web: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says Yahweh; “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you; but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”
verses.en_bbe: Have no fear, O Jacob, my servant, says the Lord; for I am with you: for I will put an end to all the nations where I have sent you, but I will not put an end to you completely: though with wise purpose I will put right your errors, and will not let you go quite without punishment.
